newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac credit extended, terms improved.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac credit extended, terms improved.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc said Wednesday its bank extended the term of the company's credit and security agreement by two years to May 31, 1999.

In light of its improved operating performance and financial condition, Ultra Pac said it also negotiated interest rate reductions on its revolving credit facility to prime plus 0.5 percent from prime plus 1.5 percent, and on its term note facility to prime plus 0.75 percent from prime plus 1.75 percent.

Ultra Pac also said it lowered the amount of its revolving credit facility to $8 million from $9.5 million as a result of its reduced credit needs. The bank has extended the maturity of the company's $825,000 mortgage note to May 31, 1999.
Ultra Pac said it paid off the $2.6 million term note extended by the bank in June 1996.
In total, the company said, it paid down its long-term debt to $20.8 million on January 31, from $29.1 million a year earlier, primarily through cash flow from operations.
